project.name: whatsapp-desktop
project.description: Native WhatsApp Web wrapper for Linux built with Rust and Tauri v2

nodes.name: Desktop Lifecycle & Memory Optimization
nodes.summary: Governs the native Linux process lifecycle, system tray integration, window event interception, and glibc memory optimizations to keep memory footprint under control.

businessRules: Window close requests (Alt+F4 or close button) must be intercepted and minimized to tray instead of quitting.
Glibc memory allocations must be bounded by setting MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_=131072 and MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 before GTK initialization.
Periodic background memory trimming (malloc_trim(0)) runs every 300 seconds to release unmapped pages back to Linux kernel.
Immediate malloc_trim(0) is executed when the user minimizes the window to tray.
System tray provides 'Open' (restore & focus) and 'Quit' (clean process termination).
crossDomainInteractions: Provides runtime host and Webview container for WhatsApp Web bridge
Coordinates process background state with notification dispatching
Reclaims memory spikes caused by clipboard image decoding

nodes.name: Message Notification & Unread Alerts
nodes.summary: Bridges web notification events and document title changes from WhatsApp Web into native Linux desktop notifications via notify-send daemon.

businessRules: Intercept standard browser window.Notification API and route to Rust notify IPC command.
Debounce notifications: drop duplicate title:body alerts within 10 seconds and enforce minimum 3-second spacing between any alerts.
Poll document.title every 2 seconds for badge pattern '(N)' as an unread message fallback.
Invoke Linux notify-send asynchronously in a detached OS thread with WhatsApp icon and 8000ms duration.
crossDomainInteractions: Triggered by WhatsApp Web JavaScript bridge injected into Webview
Restricted to permitted remote origin via Tauri ACL capability
Sends desktop alerts while application is minimized to system tray

nodes.name: Clipboard & Rich Media Integration
nodes.summary: Overcomes WebKitGTK Linux limitation where async clipboard APIs do not support image data, providing seamless text and image paste into WhatsApp chat input.

businessRules: WebKitGTK does not expose image formats through navigator.clipboard.read() or standard paste events.
Capture-phase paste listener intercepts Ctrl+V, checks for clipboard image via Rust native arboard, and suppresses default browser paste if image exists.
Rust backend reads raw RGBA buffer, encodes as PNG in-memory, and returns Base64 data URI to Webview.
Frontend constructs a File object and dispatches a synthetic DragEvent('drop') to the WhatsApp contenteditable editor to trigger image upload.
Fallback strategy writes File back into DataTransfer if drop event is unhandled.
Override navigator.clipboard.read() so UI 'Paste' button falls back to Rust clipboard helper.
crossDomainInteractions: Exposes custom Tauri IPC commands protected by security capabilities
Generates in-memory PNG buffers that are cleaned up by glibc malloc trimming

nodes.name: Security Boundaries & Tauri ACL
nodes.summary: Defines access control lists and runtime capabilities, restricting remote WhatsApp origin to only necessary core webview, tray, and custom IPC commands.

businessRules: Only allow remote execution permissions for https://web.whatsapp.com/* and https://*.whatsapp.com/*.
Restrict accessible Tauri permissions to core:default, core:webview:default, core:tray:default, and opener:default.
Expose only explicit custom commands: notify, clipboard_read_text, clipboard_has_image, clipboard_read_image_base64.
Prevent arbitrary filesystem access, shell execution, or remote origin spoofing.
crossDomainInteractions: Enforces capability boundaries on the WhatsApp Web bridge script
Validates IPC invocations originating from WebviewWindow

nodes.name: Application Boot & Memory Tuning Flow
nodes.summary: Initializes process environment variables, builds system tray, initializes WebviewWindow with WhatsApp bridge, and launches periodic memory trimming loop.

nodes.name: Set glibc Memory Tunables
nodes.summary: Configures MALLOC_TRIM_THRESHOLD_=131072 and MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 before starting Tauri and WebKitGTK runtimes.

nodes.name: Register System Tray & Handlers
nodes.summary: Builds system tray menu with Open and Quit menu items, attaching event handlers to unminimize window or terminate app.

nodes.name: Create Webview Loading WhatsApp
nodes.summary: Constructs WebviewWindow pointing to https://web.whatsapp.com, sets custom Chrome User-Agent, and registers WHATSAPP_BRIDGE script.

nodes.name: Spawn Background Memory Trimmer
nodes.summary: Starts a background OS thread that sleeps for 300 seconds and calls malloc_trim(0) in an infinite loop.

nodes.name: Minimize to Tray & Restore Flow
nodes.summary: Handles close window requests by intercepting event, hiding window to tray, running malloc_trim, and restoring on user demand.

nodes.name: Intercept Close Request
nodes.summary: Listens for WindowEvent::CloseRequested and calls api.prevent_close() to cancel window destruction.

nodes.name: Minimize Window to Tray
nodes.summary: Invokes window.minimize() to remove application from desktop taskbar while keeping background process alive.

nodes.name: Trigger Immediate malloc_trim
nodes.summary: Invokes libc malloc_trim(0) immediately after minimizing to free unused WebKit buffer pages.

nodes.name: Restore Window from Tray
nodes.summary: Handles tray 'Open' menu click by calling window.show(), window.unminimize(), and window.set_focus().

nodes.name: Incoming Message Alerting Flow
nodes.summary: Intercepts web Notification constructor in WhatsApp Web, applies rate-limiting debounce, and dispatches native notify-send alert.

nodes.name: Intercept window.Notification
nodes.summary: Replaces window.Notification with bridge function and overrides permission property to 'granted'.

nodes.name: Debounce & Rate-Limit Alert
nodes.summary: Checks last notify timestamp (drops <3s intervals) and compares composite key title+body (drops duplicate within 10s).

nodes.name: Invoke Tauri Notify IPC
nodes.summary: Calls window.__TAURI__.core.invoke('notify', { title, body }) to bridge message payload into Rust backend.

nodes.name: Execute notify-send Subprocess
nodes.summary: Spawns detached OS worker thread executing notify-send -a WhatsApp -t 8000 -i whatsapp with message title and body.

nodes.name: Document Title Unread Poller Flow
nodes.summary: Monitors WhatsApp Web tab title every 2 seconds to extract unread message badges and trigger desktop alerts.

nodes.name: Poll Document Title Interval
nodes.summary: Checks document.title every 2000ms and filters out repeated title states.

nodes.name: Extract Unread Count via Regex
nodes.summary: Applies /\((\d+)\)/ regex to title string to capture message count or detect contact name title format.

nodes.name: Trigger Badge Desktop Notification
nodes.summary: Dispatches unread count alert to notifyRust helper for debounced delivery.

nodes.name: Image Paste & Synthetic Drop Bridge Flow
nodes.summary: Intercepts Ctrl+V paste events, extracts raw clipboard bitmap via arboard, encodes PNG, and drops File object into chat editor.

nodes.name: Capture Paste Event
nodes.summary: Attaches capture-phase listener on document paste event, halting immediate propagation when native clipboard holds image data.

nodes.name: Check Clipboard Image State
nodes.summary: Invokes clipboard_has_image IPC command to check whether arboard can read a valid image from system clipboard.

nodes.name: Encode Raw Bitmap to PNG
nodes.summary: Rust backend extracts RGBA buffer, encodes as PNG using image crate in memory, and returns Base64 data URI.

nodes.name: Synthesize & Dispatch Drop Event
nodes.summary: Fetches Base64 blob, creates File object, constructs DataTransfer, and dispatches synthetic DragEvent('drop') onto message input box.

nodes.name: Async Clipboard API Fallback Flow
nodes.summary: Wraps navigator.clipboard.read() to provide native Rust fallback when WebKitGTK async clipboard read fails.

nodes.name: Patch navigator.clipboard.read
nodes.summary: Saves original read function and replaces it with error-catching wrapper.

nodes.name: Fallback to Native Clipboard Reader
nodes.summary: Calls clipboard_read_image_base64 or clipboard_read_text to retrieve data from native arboard backend.

nodes.name: Construct ClipboardItem Array
nodes.summary: Wraps recovered text or image Blob into ClipboardItem instances and resolves Promise.

nodes.name: Security Capability & ACL Enforcement Flow
nodes.summary: Configures and verifies Tauri v2 capability definitions and remote origin permissions for WhatsApp Web.

nodes.name: Validate Remote URL Whitelist
nodes.summary: Ensures remote URLs are restricted to https://web.whatsapp.com/* and https://*.whatsapp.com/*.

nodes.name: Grant Minimum Required Permissions
nodes.summary: Allows core:default, core:webview:default, core:tray:default, and opener:default while blocking shell/fs access.

Notification IPC commands authenticated by Tauri ACL
